production_diff_from_upstream: Only pre-existing 3-line labels.MatchesNothing guard in direct/lister.go. All other differences are tests, experiments, and workflows.

source_observations.claim: PSA installs PodListerFromInformer, whose ListPods ignores ctx and calls the contextless namespace lister
source_observations.interpretation: The new direct context-aware ListPods method is not reached through this adapter. Existing informer API also lacked caller context; do not claim a regression from original request identity propagation.

source_observations.claim: Node authorizer receives shared Pod informer and registers an event handler
source_observations.interpretation: Stage 1 source still has a consumer of Informer(), so lister-only elimination is insufficient to establish total informer elimination.

source_observations.claim: Existing informer factory trims managedFields; direct wrapper is installed afterwards
source_observations.interpretation: Transformation parity is separate from Scheme conversion parity.

unmeasured_followups.question: Does component-level parity hold through the real Pod REST store and watch cache?
unmeasured_followups.design: Same fixture and versioned object set via existing cache-backed storage test infrastructure; compare normalized values and source snapshots using unchanged masks; preserve actual path receipts.

unmeasured_followups.question: What net resources does migration save when real event consumers remain?
unmeasured_followups.design: Factorial lister strategy x event-consumer presence; fixed Pod population and update/read workload; measure retained heap, allocations, CPU, watcher count, and verified outcomes in separately randomized process trials.

unmeasured_followups.question: Do error and freshness contracts remain acceptable?
unmeasured_followups.design: Benign absent/deleted/recreated fixture objects and controlled version transitions; compare error classes and object identity, synchronize snapshots by observed resourceVersion rather than timing sleeps; register allowable staleness before running.
